title: Low-Level Design (Firmware Workflow)

node_notes.emit: This step records that firmware has started; it is the only runtime action shown by the application source. firmware/app/app.c emits the ESP_LOGI message at line 9.
node_notes.start: This step transfers control to the vendor-agnostic application startup function. main/entry.c calls app_start at line 6.
node_notes.boot: This step enters the ESP-IDF application hook. main/entry.c defines app_main at line 4.
